answer_1.quote: We propose DEXPERTS, a decoding-time method for controlled text generation ... We first apply DEXPERTS to the task of language detoxification ... We then showcase the generalizability of DEXPERTS by tackling the task of controlling the sentiment of LMs' output ...
datasets: Jigsaw Unintended Bias in Toxicity Classification
answer_1.outputs: Continuations for prompts with controlled attributes (e.g., non-toxic, positive/negative sentiment)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our generations for toxicity, fluency, and diversity. Following previous work, we characterize generation toxicity using the toxicity score from Perspective API ... Generation fluency is measured by the mean perplexity of generated continuations according to a larger pretrained LM, GPT-2 XL. Generation diversity is measured using the mean number of distinct n-grams ...

answer_4.quote: we carry out a human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk ... Each comparison pair is rated by three Turkers, who select which of the two continuations is: (1) less toxic, (2) more fluent, and (3) more topical ...
answer_4.guideline: select which of the two continuations is: (1) less toxic, (2) more fluent, and (3) more topical
